instructions:
Each item is an ontology term that a column of sample metadata in a gene
expression study can mean. Write up to 5 aliases for each term: other ways a
researcher would write that same variable as a column header in sample
metadata.

Good aliases:
- common abbreviations and acronyms ("sbp" for systolic blood pressure)
- shorter everyday phrasings ("systolic bp", "visual acuity")
- the plain name of the quantity when the term's label is wordy
  ("intraocular pressure" for "intraocular pressure measurement")

Rules:
- An alias must mean the same variable as the term: not a broader or narrower
  one, and not a related one.
- No values ("male", "high"), units on their own, gene or tool names, or
  dataset-specific codes.
- No alias that only rewords the label trivially (plural, case,
  punctuation). Those are matched already.
- Fewer is better than wrong. If a term has no natural alias, return an empty
  list.

Examples:
- systolic blood pressure -> ["sbp", "systolic bp", "systolic pressure"]
- intraocular pressure measurement -> ["intraocular pressure", "iop"]
- visual acuity measurement -> ["visual acuity", "va"]

items.label: collection latitude
items.definition: The latitude at which a sample was obtained. For example a sea water sample.

items.label: collection longitude
items.definition: The longitude at which a sample was obtained. For example a sea water sample.

items.label: hair morphology
items.definition: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the fine, keratinized filamentous growths arising from the epidermis of mammals.

items.label: 454 GS 20 standard manufacturer's protocol
items.definition: The standard protocol supplied by the manufacturer of the 454 GS 20 sequencer for nucleic acid sequencing protocol.

items.label: age at death
items.definition: The age at which death occurs.

items.label: tyrosine measurement
items.definition: The quantification of some tyrosine, typically obtained from an individual with the intention of using the measurement in some diagnostic process.

items.definition: quantification of the pneumoprotein surfactant protein D. This protein is an innate immune protein and plays a role in pulmonary host defence and the modulation of allergic responses.  Several human lung diseases are characterized by decreased levels of bronchoalveolar SP-D.

items.definition: quantification of some lipid or lipoprotein

items.label: body composition measurement
items.definition: measurement of the percentages of fat, bone and muscle in human bodies

items.label: arm span
items.definition: Distance between the tips of the longest fingers with the arms maximally outstretched laterally.

items.label: energy expenditure
items.definition: energy expenditure is generally considered to be the sum of internal heat produced and external work through physical activity

items.label: gestational age
items.definition: The age of the conceptus, beginning from the time of FERTILIZATION. In clinical obstetrics, the gestational age is often estimated as the time from the last day of the last MENSTRUATION which is about 2 weeks before OVULATION and fertilization.

items.label: metabolic rate measurement
items.definition: a quantification of metabolic rate

items.label: antioxidant measurement
items.definition: quantification of some antioxidant in a biological sample

items.label: cancer biomarker measurement
items.definition: cancer biomarkers, such as cancer antigen 19-9, carcinoembryonic antigen and α fetoprotein, are used as indicators for cancer screening and as predictors for therapeutic responses and prognoses in cancer patient

items.label: albumin:globulin ratio measurement
items.definition: quantification of the ratio of the protein albumin to globulin in the blood serum

items.definition:
quantification of 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid in cerebrospinal fluid or urine. 5-HIAA is a metabolite of serotonin.

items.label: amino acid measurement
items.definition: quantification of some amino acid in a biological assay

items.label: strain
items.definition: A population of organisms that is geneticaly different from others of the same species and possessing a set of defined characteristics.

items.label: cultivar
items.definition: A cultivated plant variety selected and given a name because it has desirable characteristics that distinguish it from otherwise similar plants of the same species.

items.label: C-peptide measurement
items.definition:
A measurement of the connecting peptide, or C-peptide -  a short 31-amino-acid polypeptide that connects insulin's A-chain to its B-chain in the proinsulin molecule. C-peptide measurements may be made for clinical diagnostics.

items.label: respiratory quotient
items.definition: The respiratory quotient (or RQ or respiratory coefficient), is a dimensionless number used in calculations of basal metabolic rate (BMR) when estimated from carbon dioxide production. Such measurements, like measurements of oxygen uptake, are forms of indirect calorimetry.

items.label: serum IgG glycosylation measurement
items.definition: quantification of N-linked IgG glycans in a serum sample

items.label: renal transplant outcome measurement
items.definition: quantification of the outcome of a kidney transplant

items.label: oligoclonal band measurement
items.definition: detection or quantification of bands of immunoglobulins in blood serum or cerebrospinal fluid, usually as an indicator of central nervous system disorders such as multiple sclerosis, Lyme disease, systemic lupus erythematosus or neurosarcoidosis

items.label: aspirin hydrolysis measurement
items.definition: quantification of the rate of hydrolysis of aspirin in blood as an indicator of the therapeutic effectiveness of aspirin

items.label: central corneal thickness
items.definition: A measure of the corneal thickness (CCT). This can be measured by contact e.g. ultrasound, confocal microscpy or non contact methods e.g. biometry. Reduced central corneal thickness is used as an indicator for glaucoma.

items.label: plant population
items.definition: A plant population is a grouping of plants consisting of individuals which share a particular characteristic such as inhabiting a particular region or area or ability to interbreed.

items.label: breed
items.definition: A breed is a specific group of domestic animals or plants having homogeneous appearance, homogeneous behavior, and other characteristics that distinguish it from other animals or plants of the same species and that were arrived at through selective breeding.

items.label: employment status
items.definition: quantification of an individual's occupation, both in terms of employment vs unemployment and in terms of nature of employment, eg self-employment

items.label: serum copper measurement
items.definition: quantification of copper in blood used in the diagnosis of Wilson's disease (in combination with ceruloplasmin measurement) or copper deficiences. Low levels may indicate Wilson's disease, high levels may indicate liver disease.

items.label: cardiovascular disease biomarker measurement
items.definition: cardiovascular disease biomarkers, such as ST2 cardiac biomarker and C-reactive protein, are used as indicators for cardiovascular disease and as predictors for therapeutic responses

items.label: allergic sensitization measurement
items.definition: quantification of allergic sensitization status, for example through measurement of allergen-specific IgE in the blood or skin reaction after puncture of skin through a droplet of allergen extract (skin prick test)

items.label: induced mutation
items.definition: A genetic transformation that the modification of the genetic material (either coding or non-coding) of an organism is caused by mutagenic compounds or irradiation

items.label: axial length measurement
items.definition: quantification of the distance between the anterior surface of the cornea and the fovea, usually measured by A-scan ultrasonography or optical coherence biometry

items.label: post-operative sign or symptom
items.definition: clinical manifestation that occurs as a result of a surgical intervention

items.label: joint damage measurement
items.definition: quantification of the level of joint damage, eg through radiological analysis

items.label: contrast sensitivity measurement
items.definition: quantificiation of ability to detect sharp boundaries (stimuli) and to detect slight changes in luminance at regions without distinct contours. Psychophysical measurements of this visual function are used to evaluate visual acuity and to detect eye disease.

items.label: borderline personality disorder symptom
items.definition: Symptom associated with borderline personality disorder such as unstable self-image and mood together with volatile interpersonal relationships, self-damaging impulsivity, recurrent suicidal threats or gestures and/or self-mutilating behavior

items.label: array control design
items.definition: An array design in which a reporter is used a control for reasons such as quality or result verifcation.

items.label: estrogen receptor status
items.definition: quantification of the level of estrogen receptors in a tumor

items.label: progesterone receptor status
items.definition: quantification of  progesterone receptors in breast cancer. PR status is used in the classification of breast cancers.

items.label: HER2 status
items.definition: quantification of the level of human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) in a tumor. Amplification or overexpression of the HER2 oncogene plays a role in the development and progression of some breast cancers.

items.label: sample collection protocol
items.definition: Describes the procedure whereby biological samples for an experiment are sourced.

items.label: dissection protocol
items.definition: Describes the procedure which dissects biological materials into anatomical sub-components, e.g. specific organs or tissues.

items.label: conversion protocol
items.definition: Describes the conversion of samples (e.g. RNA samples) to another form (e.g. complementary DNA) with no prior dedicated extraction step of the former form, and no labeling of the converted product with chemical tags or dyes during the process. items.label: technology type
items.definition: The technology type or platform of the reporters on the array.

items.label: substrate type
items.definition: Controlled terms for descriptors of types of array substrates.

items.label: surface type
items.definition: Controlled terms for descriptors for coating of the substrate.

items.label: Trypanosoma cruzi seropositivity
items.definition: Trypanosoma cruzi seropositivity is the result of a measurement of circulating T. cruzi specific antibodies

items.label: nitric oxide exhalation measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the fraction of nitric oxide in the total exhalation volume, used as a non-invasive biomarker of eosinophilic airway inflammation. Higher Feno values are associated with childhood asthma symptoms, exacerbations, physician-diagnosed asthma and atopy.

items.label: thrombin generation potential measurement
items.definition: quantification of the capacity of a given individual to generate thrombin, measured in plasma and shown to associate with thrombotic disorders

items.label: breast cancer stage
items.definition: A staging of breast cancer for example by the American Joint Committee on Cancer, stage 7, or other coding system.

items.label: cortical opacity measurement
items.definition: A measure of cortical opacity used in the diagnosis of cataract.

items.label: prostate cancer staging
items.definition: A classification of prostate cancer stage e.g. Gleason grade finding

items.label: CEL data file format
items.definition: CEL data file format describes the format used in a CEL file for storing the results of the intensity calculations on the pixel values of a DAT file. items.label: white matter hyperintensity measurement
items.definition: quantification of white matter hyperintensity, usually measured by MRI

items.definition: quantification of the microstructre of the white matter of the brain

items.definition: quantification of the onset of puberty in human males and females through a series of proxy measurements such as genital enlargement (males) or breast development (females). items.label: oxygen saturation measurement
items.definition: quantification of the relative amount of oxygen that is dissolved or carried in a given medium

items.label: non-high density lipoprotein cholesterol measurement
items.definition: The quantification of NHDL cholesterol in blood, calculated by subtracting the amount of cholesterol in the HDL fraction from total cholesterol and used as an indicator for cardiovascular disease risk

items.label: plasma trimethylamine N-oxide measurement
items.definition: The quantification in blood of trimethylamine N-oxide, a product of gut microbiome and hepatic-mediated metabolism of dietary choline and L-carnitine

items.label: skin wound
items.definition: an injury to the skin caused by a cut, blow, or other impact.

items.definition: quantification of rheumatoid factors, antibodies in the serum of individuals with rheumatoid arthritis that react with antigenic determinants or immunoglobulins that enhance agglutination of suspended particles coated with pooled human gamma -globulin. items.definition: quantification of the hormone cortisol in blood or urine

items.label: hemoglobin A2 measurement
items.definition: The determination of the amount of hemoglobin A2 present in a sample. [ NCI ]
